name: longterm-erosion
why: Finding 4 in MEMORY_CORE_PLAN: the long-term summary is rewritten from scratch every fold, so early material survives only if the model keeps choosing it. Three separate sessions, two durable facts each; after the third fold all six must still be somewhere in long-term memory (summary or facts). This is the baseline the planned consolidation/episodes work is meant to beat.

messages: Sorry I'm late — the tide samples ran over. Occupational hazard of being a marine biologist.
*Mira hands her a towel.* "You smell like a rock pool."
Charming. Gus needs feeding when we get in, too.
My tortoise. He's forty-one. He was my grandmother's.
*drops a cello case by the door* Quartet rehearsal ran long. Brahms, again.
"You play cello? How did I not know this?"
Since I was seven. I'm second chair in the Harbour Street Quartet.
"Second chair. Very distinguished." *She opens the fridge.* "Ham sandwich?"
I'm vegetarian — have been for ten years. Cheese is fine.
Don't make me go up the lighthouse stairs. I'm terrified of heights, I mean it.
*Mira stops on the first step.* "Okay. Ground floor it is."
Thank you. Mum would laugh at me. Anjali's not scared of anything.
